# REDTEAM #181 (SPEC Sec 8.3, T-301.1): a loop back-edge MUST restore the
# watermark for iteration-local objects; a loop with only iteration-local
# allocation MUST NOT grow arena use across iterations. This script runs the
# bounded-watermark unit gates under the arena experiment.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena
go test -v -count=1 -run 'TestLogosArenaLoopWatermarkBounded|TestLogosArenaSwitchBreakWatermarkBounded|TestLogosArenaSelectBreakWatermarkBounded' runtime
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosArenaLoopWatermarkBounded'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosArenaSwitchBreakWatermarkBounded'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosArenaSelectBreakWatermarkBounded'
stdout '^ok\s+runtime'
! stderr 'no tests to run'
go test -race -v -count=1 -run 'TestLogosArenaLoopWatermarkBounded|TestLogosArenaSwitchBreakWatermarkBounded|TestLogosArenaSelectBreakWatermarkBounded' runtime
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosArenaLoopWatermarkBounded'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosArenaSwitchBreakWatermarkBounded'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosArenaSelectBreakWatermarkBounded'
stdout '^ok\s+runtime'
! stderr 'no tests to run'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/redteam181

go 1.27
